posts.title: The Overall Shift Of Tech From Normal Browising To AI Driven Workflows
posts.summary: The entire internet is shifting towards the AI era. Normal browser browsing is now negligible among youth as AI research platforms replace manual search.
posts.excerpt: The entire internet is shifting towards the AI era. Normal browser browsing is now negligible among youth as AI research platforms replace manual search.
posts.content:
The entire internet is shifting towards the ai era. Normal browser browsing is nwo negligle among the youths. Most people are using the ai platforms for doing research rather than doing search job by self. Certainly there will be saturation point in near future, but hey, it'll be ride of technicnological war.

### The Search Paradigm Shift

Where we once opened 10 Google search result tabs, compared contradictory answers, and read through clutter, agentic workflows now condense complex answers into verified execution steps in seconds.

### Where Statistics Meets Intelligence

In statistics, predictive models and Bayesian inference rely on probability distributions. Today's generative systems operate on token probabilities across billions of parameters. Understanding the statistical foundations behind these models is becoming the most valuable skill for researchers and analysts in Nepal and globally.

posts.title: The Rhythm of Numbers and Strings: Why I Started Documenting My Journey
posts.summary: Between calculating confidence intervals and fingerpicking acoustic chords late into the night, I realized that statistics and music are two languages speaking the same truth. This is why I document my life.
posts.excerpt: Between calculating confidence intervals and fingerpicking acoustic chords late into the night, I realized that statistics and music are two languages speaking the same truth. This is why I document my life.
posts.content:
### Two Worlds, One Cadence

People often ask me why someone who spends hours deriving probability distributions and designing multi-stage survey questionnaires also spends hours with a guitar resting across his knees.

To many, mathematics is cold and logical, while acoustic music is emotional and spontaneous. But the deeper I go into both, the more I see that they are fundamentally the same discipline: **finding harmony inside noise**.

### The Math of Music

When you fret a chord—whether it is a simple open Em or a rich, resonant add9—you are not just playing music. You are manipulating physical ratios of string length and acoustic frequency. Pythagoras knew this centuries ago: harmonics are pure arithmetic.

In statistics, when we analyze variance in survey data, we are listening for the underlying signal against background error. When I practice fingerpicking, each note must be placed precisely on time, yet breathe with emotion. Precision without soul is sterile calculation; soul without structure is chaos.

### Why I Document Here

I built this digital garden not just as a portfolio for jobs or academic applications, but as a permanent, open ledger of growth. As a final-year statistics student at Tri-Chandra Multiple Campus in Kathmandu, life is moving fast—field surveys, regression models, coding scripts in Python, and acoustic covers recorded in quiet rooms.

By syncing my Google Docs directly from Google Drive into this space, I can write whenever inspiration strikes, whether on my phone or laptop, and share my honest thoughts with whoever stumbles across this site.

Thank you for reading, and welcome to my journey.

posts.title: Turning Light Into Sight: How the 2026 Nobel Prize in Optogenetics Is Transforming Treatment for Retinitis Pigmentosa and Beyond
